Parameters.Name: pBaseURL
Parameters.Prompt: Base URL of the target PA SaaS tenant, e.g. https://us-east-1.planninganalytics.saas.ibm.com (blank = this tenant)

Parameters.Name: pTenantID
Parameters.Prompt: Tenant ID of the target (blank = this tenant)

Parameters.Name: pApiKey
Parameters.Prompt: API key for the target (blank = keep the current key)

Parameters.Name: pTest
Parameters.Prompt: 1 = test the connection first and save only if it works
